sentence_stem: What the students found most difficult
correct_completion: was the timing of the presentations.
full_sentence: What the students found most difficult was the timing of the presentations.
acceptable_variants: was keeping to the time limit.
was managing the time for each speaker.

options.why_wrong: This is a complete clause, but a pseudo-cleft needs 'was' followed by the element that answers the 'What' clause.

options.text: because they had no time to prepare.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a reason. The stem needs a complement that identifies what the students found difficult.

options.text: was the timing of the presentations.
although they had practiced a lot.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' introduces a contrast, but the stem needs a complement naming the difficulty.

grammar_focus: Pseudo-cleft sentences with a 'What' clause followed by 'was'
explanation: A pseudo-cleft sentence starts with a 'What' clause and continues with 'was' plus the element that answers it. The completion must name the difficulty.
translation: Lo que los estudiantes encontraron más difícil fue la programación de las presentaciones.
